item.title: Iran-linked hackers took U.K. power plant offline for first time, reports say
item.description: The attack happened the same month Iranian-linked hackers are believed to have targeted the water systems of a dozen U.S. states.

item.title: U.S. unveils new sanctions after Trump threatened "economic D-Day"
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said new sanctions being imposed on Iran would amount to the "greatest financial offensive" ever.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Aug. 23)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Firefighters battle flames and smoke near Reno fueled by drought and wind
item.description: Firefighters are working to contain the Hawk Fire near Reno, Nevada, after drought and high winds fueled the flames. CBS News' Jason Allen has more.

item.title: Prosecution in Lindsay Clancy trial focuses on psychological experts in rebuttal testimony
item.description: The prosecution in the Lindsay Clancy trial continues to call rebuttal witnesses, mainly focusing on the psychological aspects of Clancy's state of mind when she killed her 3 children. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul and legal contributor Jessica Levinson have more.

item.title: Trial lawyer on how Lindsay Clancy jury may weigh expert testimony
item.description: The trial for Lindsay Clancy is nearing its end with closing arguments expected this week. Mark Eiglarsh, trial lawyer and former prosecutor, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Watch Live: Lindsay Clancy trial continues with rebuttal witnesses
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy trial​ resumed with prosecution rebuttal witnesses taking the stand in the Massachusetts murder case.

item.title: Bessent announces campaign to create "economic onslaught" against Iran and its partners
item.description: The Trump administration is trying to pull all economic levers at its disposal to cripple Tehran.

item.title: Watch: Bessent announces "economic D-Day" sanction plan for Iran, Iranian trade partners
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Monday announced an "economic onslaught" against Iran in the latest U.S. effort to put pressure on the Iranian regime. CBS News' Aaron Navarro, Javier David and Courtney Kealy have more.

item.title: Redfin and Zillow must change agreement that hurts competition, FTC says
item.description: Federal regulators alleged that a $100 million deal between Redfin and Zillow stifled competition for apartment listings.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell reveals which celebrity she would like to work out with
item.description: Norah O'Donnell's personal trainer, Kira Stokes, asks the "Healthful" podcast host what her least favorite exercise is, which celebrity she would like to join her workout and when she feels mentally and physically the strongest.

item.title: Out-of-control Hawk Fire in Reno keeping tens of thousands evacuated
item.description: Shifting winds challenged firefighters battling the out-of-control Hawk Fire in Reno, Nevada, that was keeping tens of thousands of people evacuated.

item.title: Trump announces 50% tariffs on Canadian automotive and steel imports
item.description: President Trump said tariffs on Canadian automotive and steel imports will rise to 50% on January 1, 2027, in a social media post.

item.title: A principal lost his job after helping a homeless student. He has no regrets.
item.description: Rob Burnside, a principal at an Ohio high school, made the decision to help one of his students, and it cost him his job.

item.title: A massive data center hub is likely heating up a town outside London
item.description: Researchers say residents of Slough, just outside London, are likely very literally feeling the heat from a massive cluster of data centers in their town.

item.title: $10,000 9-month CD vs. $10,000 high-yield savings account: Which will earn more by 2027?
item.description: Interest rates on both account types remain high. But will the returns look much different over the next nine months?

item.title: Washington Post ordered to reinstate columnist fired after Charlie Kirk posts
item.description: The ruling said the newspaper did not have sufficient cause to terminate Karen Attiah, who at the time was the last Black full-time member of the Post's opinion desk.

item.title: Trump's trade representative calls U.S.-Mexico talks constructive as Canada dispute intensifies
item.description: United States Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told CBS News' Weijia Jiang that trade talks with Canada are suspended as threats of more tariffs loom, while calling talks with Mexico "constructive."

item.title: Trump tries to fight Iran war with sanctions
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to announce more sanctions against Iran as the war continues. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: The Best new restaurants of 2026, according to Bon Appétit
item.description: Bon Appétit has released its 2026 list of the best new restaurants in the U.S. Editor-in-Chief Jamila Robinson joins CBS News alongside Kabawa chef Paul Carmichael to discuss the fresh additions.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial reaches last stage of testimony before closing arguments
item.description: There are a few more witnesses expected on the stand for rebuttals before the Lindsay Clancy murder trial moves on to jury instructions and closing arguments. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul and Caroline Polisi have more.

item.title: Stars and Stripes reporter reacts to being fired by Hegseth's Pentagon
item.description: Lara Korte, a former Middle East reporter for the Stars and Stripes, a U.S. military news outlet that is partially funded by American taxpayers, joined CBS News 24/7 with her reaction to her firing by the Pentagon.

item.title: Navy sailor on USS Lincoln says dad was arrested by immigration officials
item.description: Historically rare, immigration arrests of military spouses and parents have become more common under the second Trump administration.

item.title: USS Lincoln sailor's dad arrested by ICE, family says
item.description: U.S. Navy sailor Joshua Aviles, who is aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, says he learned his father was arrested by federal immigration officials. Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.

item.title: Trump administration's ICE detains Navy sailor's dad, sends Latino migrants to Africa
item.description: A Navy sailor deployed aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln says ICE detained his dad while he is overseas. This comes as more details are emerging about migrants being deported to countries in Africa. CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez.

item.title: Jared Kushner and Hakeem Jeffries met as midterm elections loom
item.description: The meeting came with Democrats expected to take control of the House in the November elections, which would put Jeffries in line to become the next House speaker.

item.title: Principal sacrifices job to help homeless student
item.description: A former Ohio principal lost his job after allowing a homeless student to remain in school after the district unenrolled him. He and his wife eventually became the student's legal guardians. CBS News contributor David Begnaud shares the story.

item.title: How Trump's economic offensives against Iran and Canada will impact American wallets
item.description: President Trump is imposing tariffs on Canada after talks stalled. This comes as the White House prepares to announce more sanctions against Iran. Threadneedle's Ann Berry joins CBS News with her take, and Shikha Jain, a partner at Simon-Kucher, joins with more insight.

item.title: Trump targets Canada and Iran with economic pressure
item.description: The Trump administration is navigating rough waters with Canada and Iran by applying economic pressure. CBS News' Aaron Navarro and Aaron MacLean have more.

item.title: Robin Wall Kimmerer on the wonders of nature
item.description: The botanist's bestselling books, "Braiding Sweetgrass" and "The Serviceberry," advocate for living and working in collaboration with the Earth, and sharing the gifts of nature - ideas, she says, some may see as subversive.
